enrichment.summary: This resolution extends the date for submitting housing recommendations. They relate to a Board effort on housing for unsheltered students and families and district employees, and to Board Policy 7351. The official text does not state the new date. No cost is listed.

outcome.action: Adopted

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

enrichment.headline: Approves the 2021-2022 school-year calendar for the district's Young Adult Program
enrichment.summary: The Board approves the 2021-2022 academic calendar for the district's Young Adult Program. The official text gives no dates or dollar amounts. It is listed under the General Purpose Fund.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: District's Young Adult Program (YAP) - Academic (School Year) Calendar - 2021-2022

enrichment.headline: Ratifies adding $5,000 to a school safety plan consultant's contract, for a $35,000 total
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $5,000 to a consultant's agreement, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $30,000 to $35,000. The consultant documents the school safety design meetings, reviews practices in other districts, helps plan implementation and budget, and will build a plan to evaluate the Safety Plan. The period is September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021, and the Board is ratifying after work began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Moira De Nike - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $20,000 for a facilitator for the school safety plan design team
enrichment.summary: The district hired an individual consultant to lead facilitation and process design for the Safety Plan design team, workgroups and listening sessions, and to help with follow-up documentation. The Safety Plan aims to provide new models of school safety without police. The period is April 1 through June 30, 2021, and the Board is ratifying after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Gregory E Hodge - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for Be the Change Consulting to facilitate school safety plan work
enrichment.summary: The district hired Be the Change Consulting to lead facilitation and process design for the Safety Plan design team, workgroups and listening sessions, and to help with follow-up documentation. The period is April 1 through June 30, 2021, and the Board is ratifying after the start date. The Office of the Chief of Staff oversees it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Be the Change Consulting - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.summary: The Board authorizes the Superintendent to sign, for the district, a petition in favor of forming the Oakland Chinatown Community Benefit District. The official text does not state any cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board authorizes the Superintendent to sign, for the district, a petition in favor of renewing and expanding the Fruitvale Business Improvement District. The official text does not state any cost to the district.

enrichment.headline: Adds $3.57M and a year to Cahill/Focon's Fremont High library renovation, for a $98.87M total
enrichment.summary: This addendum adds $3,568,980 for the Library Renovation Project within the Fremont High School new construction work, an agreement with Cahill/Focon JV under a lease-leaseback arrangement. It raises the not-to-exceed amount from $95,301,226 to $98,870,206 and extends the end date from December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021 (365 more days). The old end date had passed before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Cuts Mar Con Builder's Laurel finishing kitchen contract by $17,273.51 for unused allowance
enrichment.summary: This change order is a credit to the district. It returns the unused allowance on the Laurel Finishing Kitchen Project, lowering Mar Con Builder, Inc.'s contract price from $2,732,000 to $2,714,726.49. The completion date stays July 25, 2019.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $1.01M and 72 days to Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse's Foster The Center greenhouse and kitchen work
enrichment.summary: This change order adds $1,007,816.07 for greenhouse, pizza oven and outdoor sink improvements on the Foster The Center Project. The builder works under a lease-leaseback contract (a district construction arrangement). The not-to-exceed amount rises from $49,653,317.84 to $50,661,133.91, and the end date moves to April 30, 2021, 72 more days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: This change order closes out the Elmhurst Middle School Boiler Replacement Project with Mar Con Builders, Inc.
